name: thujone semiotic

phase_0.boundary_condition: The picrotoxin-binding site of the GABA-A receptor complex

VINIT.justification: The initial state of the molecule prior to receptor interaction.

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary that defines the limit of the inhibitory effect.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation toward the active site.

AREV.justification: The reverse transformation of the ligand from the receptor.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the bicyclic scaffold to the binding pocket.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the thujone chiral configuration.

FSPLIT.justification: The bifurcation into alpha and beta stereoisomeric pathways.

FFUSE.justification: The convergence of stereoisomeric effects into a singular inhibitory outcome.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of chloride channel blockage.

EVALF.justification: The negative state where the ligand fails to occupy the site.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice state where binding and dissociation are held simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the bicyclic framework.

phase_3.void_description: The state of the monoterpene before entering the neuro-receptor interface.
phase_3.true_description: The state of successful GABA-A receptor antagonism and channel inhibition.
phase_3.false_description: The state of non-interaction or failed binding at the picrotoxin site.
phase_3.both_description: The state of oscillatory instability where the ligand is both bound and dissociating.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the thujone molecule in the extracellular space.
Branch the molecule into its specific chiral stereoisomeric paths.
Affirm the successful binding of the alpha-thujone isomer.
Chain the stereochemical alignment to the picrotoxin site.
Recognize the rigid bicyclic identity of the scaffold.
Record the permanent structural configuration of the molecule.
Hold the oscillatory state of the ligand-receptor interface.
Evaluate the dissociation path of the beta-thujone isomer.
Reconstitute the singular neurotoxic potential from the branched paths.
Anchor the system at the closed chloride channel pore.

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system maintains structural integrity through rigid bicyclic constraints.
